confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or price sources. Restaurant anchors are moderate confidence. July accommodation anchors are least certain because Faro and the Algarve have strong peak-season price swings and taxes and fees vary by property. The FX value comes from search-result excerpts of the RBA exchange rates page, which I did not open directly; the same excerpts also cite 0.6955 for 15 October 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized southern Portuguese and Algarve tourist towns and comparable southern European coastal cities in peak summer.
